viktor: Heads-up — dashboard weirdness: p95 dropped below p50 for /internal/model-infer right after we turned on sticky-routing experiment. screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/sticky.png :eyes:
maya: That shouldn't happen. Which backend is the panel reading (sketch vs exact)?
viktor: It's the historical rollup panel backed by merged t-digests over 15m buckets. Live stream looks fine. The flip shows up at 11:07 UTC when the experiment ramped to 40%.
eli: Classic sign of uneven sample distributions across sources. Can you run per-source counts and exact percentiles?
viktor: Ran this quick debug:
```
SELECT source, count(*) AS n, approx_percentile(latency_ms,0.5) AS p50, approx_percentile(latency_ms,0.95) AS p95
FROM latency_events
WHERE route='/internal/model-infer' AND time >= now()- interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY source;
```
Results: source-a n=34 p50=9ms p95=12ms; source-b n=2460 p50=210ms p95=460ms. Merged tdigest endpoint slice showed p95=15ms p50=220ms.
maya: Yep. Small fast-source centroids overpower merge centroids when compression and centroid merge rules align poorly. Not a data correctness bug per se but a sketch artifact.
eli: Short-term UX/ops mitigations:
- show per-slice sample_count inline and a small "precision" label: exact|sketch
- add a confidence indicator derived from sample_count and number_of_sources (high/medium/low)
- annotate the panel at the experiment ramp time
- if slice_count < 200, compute exact percentiles from raw events for the UI instead of using merged sketches
viktor: I like the precision label. Also we should show the underlying data type on hover: "percentiles computed from merged sketches (approximate)" vs "exact from raw events".
maya: Backend: medium-term plan is to persist small-sample exact summaries per interval (e.g., reservoir-sampled quantiles or small HDR) alongside sketches so the UI can choose deterministically. Another option is deterministic histogram buckets for display to enforce monotonicity at display resolution.
eli: UX PR plan: I'll add the inline sample_count + precision pill and a tooltip explaining non-monotonic cases. Backend PR: add fallback path for N<200 to compute exact with tests demonstrating inversion on synthetic tdigest merges.
telemetry-bot: note: annotation "sticky-routing-experiment" added at 2025-04-02T11:07:00Z by eli.
deploy-bot: CL-4789 opened by eli for console: precision-pill + sample_count. CI queued. :rocket:
viktor: I'll file an incident blurb and tag product owners for the experiment. If we see customer-facing regressions we'll pause the ramp for the next hour. Thanks all :thumbsup:
